worldcombat.skill.mirrorcoat.summary: Reflects the most recent special damage it took at double strength; with no debt recorded, the mirror only glints.
worldcombat.skill.mirrorcoat.use.0: Answer a heavy special hit from a distance
worldcombat.skill.mirrorcoat.use.2: Turn damage taken into damage dealt from safety
worldcombat.skill.mirrorcoat.description: Fires the %1$s point refund recorded on the user; only special damage taken within the last %2$s is kept on the ledger.
Beam range %1$s blocks, %2$s blocks per tick, collision radius %3$s blocks. The refund never exceeds %4$s of the user's maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.mirrorcoat.polish.on: Polished mirror on: the ledger window is 1.2 s longer and the refund cap gains 8%, but prepare takes 3 ticks and cooldown 8 ticks more.
worldcombat.skill.mirrorcoat.polish.off: Polished mirror off: the mirror folds away faster and only the freshest debt counts.
worldcombat.skill.mirrorcoat.timing: Castable on enemies within %1$s blocks; commits after %2$s s and costs %4$s PP; recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.mirrorcoat.growth.0: At level %1$s the refund cap rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.mirrorcoat.growth.1: At level %1$s the refund cap rises to %2$s and the beam range extends to %3$s blocks.
On: the ledger window is 1.2 s longer and the refund cap gains 8%, so the mirror remembers longer and returns more, but prepare takes 3 ticks and cooldown 8 ticks more. Off: the mirror folds away faster and only the freshest debt counts.
Only fire the refund back at the debtor within this distance; a larger value commits from farther away.
